title: Emmett Hardy's first band at Midway Park
summary: Harry recalls Emmett's first band opening Midway Park across the river, and says Emmett played fine cornet in an original style.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: he played in Emmett's first band, right Harry? I think so John, that was the first band he organized up at, we opened the Midway Park up at, what was it, Harvey's Canal there, across the river?
On the other side of the river? On the other side of the river. Midway Park.

Midway Park. Yeah, I don't remember. And I remember he played very good. You don't uh... Might I say he played an original style. Ah. Very good. Did he live over across the river at that time? He did, he lived over in Algea's at that time and he played real fine. Fine cornet. Must have been very young. We might ask him...
